gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-n: Zen Kaku Gothic New reads smooth and friendly, with no thick-thin swelling anywhere. Happy Monkey's ruler-straight lines and wide-gapped e give the heading a loud personality that the sans-serif body never tries to match.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-ibm-plex-sans: IBM Plex Sans brings a wide channel into every bowl, so its text feels technical yet approachable under the heading. Happy Monkey stays the loud one up top.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-zilla-slab: Happy Monkey draws its bold, wide-gapped letters with a single-nib look, like a marker that never changes pressure. Zilla Slab follows with sturdy slab-serif text and broad openings in every bowl-ended curve.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-chillax: Loose and loopy, Chillax lays its lines out like spaghetti, while Love Ya Like A Sister stays low-slung and bold up top. Its unfinished curves keep a paragraph feeling relaxed.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-plein: Plein reads reliable and clean, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. Love Ya Like A Sister is the one with the tall, expressive lowercase, and Plein simply lets it talk.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-spline-s: Spline Sans reads contemporary and friendly, with wide gaps where curves meet stems. Love Ya Like A Sister is the louder one, with outward-pointing terminals, and Spline Sans is the one built to keep going.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink, with generous openings in every curve. Love Ya Like A Sister sits next to it feeling bolder and more expressive, like a loud friend beside a dependable one.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-aclonica: Love Ya Like A Sister has ascenders barely clearing the x-height and strokes as constant as bent wire, a quiet bold beat. Aclonica's gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight makes a longer passage feel stretched out and easy.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-allerta: Tails and terminals as thick as the stems give Love Ya Like A Sister its bold look. Allerta's prominent x-height and wide, loose tracking make the strongest contrast beside it.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-alumni-s: Alumni Sans is clean and approachable, with a wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart. Alumni Sans varies its stroke weight only slightly, while Love Ya Like A Sister stays bold and swell-free, and that quiet kinship is the pair's strength.
